heading: Errors
body:
Failures are emitted as `'error'` events carrying a `BluetoothError`. It is not exported from the module, but its `code` identifies the failure:

| Code | Emitted by | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CONNECTION_FAILED` | `Central` | A connection attempt failed. The error's `id` is the peripheral's id. |
| `DISCONNECT` | `Central` | A peripheral disconnected with an error. The error's `id` is the peripheral's id. |
| `DISCOVER_FAILED` | `Peripheral` | Discovering services or characteristics failed. |
| `READ_FAILED` | `Peripheral` | Reading a characteristic failed. |
| `WRITE_FAILED` | `Peripheral` | Writing a characteristic failed. |
| `NOTIFY_FAILED` | `Peripheral` | A notification update for a subscribed characteristic reported an error. |
| `NOTIFY_STATE_FAILED` | `Peripheral` | Changing a characteristic's notification state (subscribing or unsubscribing) failed. |
| `CHANNEL_FAILED` | `Peripheral`, `PeripheralManager` | Opening an L2CAP channel failed. |
| `ADVERTISE_FAILED` | `PeripheralManager` | Advertising failed. |
| `SERVICE_ADD_FAILED` | `PeripheralManager` | Adding a service failed. |
| `CHANNEL_PUBLISH_FAILED` | `PeripheralManager` | Publishing an L2CAP channel failed. |
